title: Run history ledger and trend detection
purpose: The 36 criteria are stated in docs/phase-15-plan.md section 12 and registered here so a criterion cannot silently lose its implementation or test.

tests/regression/p15-traceability.check.cjs asserts every row resolves to files that exist and to tests that are really registered, plus the static workflow and no-shell checks the plan assigns to it.

verifiedByMeaning.test: An executing regression test asserts the criterion. The named tests must exist. A name containing ${...} is the literal source title of a parameterised test registered in a loop.
verifiedByMeaning.platform: The behaviour belongs to a third party platform. The Falcon-side wiring is tested; the platform outcome is evidenced on hosted runs.
verifiedByMeaning.review: A documentation or process criterion evidenced by a recorded review verdict rather than by code.

criteria.text: Hosted evidence: two consecutive runs on one branch show a ledger cache miss then a hit with the record count growing (platform)
criteria.justification: A hosted-runner cache miss followed by a hit is GitHub Actions cache behaviour, not Falcon code. The workflow wiring is asserted by the AC-28 test (own key, exact path, restore and save entries); the miss-then-hit and the growing record count are evidenced in the PR from two consecutive hosted runs on one branch (restore step 'Cache not found' then 'Cache restored', ledger record count in the step summary growing between them).
